UNITED STATES SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE COMMISSION — FORM 10-Q

Apple Inc. — Quarterly Report for the quarterly period ended July 1, 2023.

Item 1. Financial Statements

Net sales for the quarter were $81.8 billion, compared to $83.0 billion in the year-ago quarter, reflecting a decline in iPhone and Mac sales partially offset by growth in Services.

Item 1A. Risk Factors

There have been no material changes to the Company's risk factors from those disclosed in Part I, Item 1A of the 2022 Form 10-K.

Item 3. Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures About Market Risk

There have been no material changes to the Company's exposure to market risk since the end of the fiscal year ended September 24, 2022.
